# bintables/syscall

> syscall: evaluate the arguments, then load them into rax, rdi, rsi, rdx, r10, r8, r9.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/syscall.pkg) · translates [std/syscall](../std/syscall.md)

The arguments are pushed from last to first and popped into the system
call registers in order, so the first argument (the call number) lands in
`rax`. One variant per argument count, from 1 to 7.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when args count 1`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
syscall
```

### `emit when args count 2`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
pop rdi
syscall
```

### `emit when args count 3`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
pop rdi
pop rsi
syscall
```

### `emit when args count 4`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
pop rdi
pop rsi
pop rdx

```

### `emit when args count 5`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
pop rdi
pop rsi
pop rdx
pop r10
syscall
```

### `emit when args count 6`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
pop rax
pop rdi
pop rsi
pop rdx
pop r10
pop r8

```

### `emit when args count 7`

```nasm

pop r8
pop r9
```
